title: Benchmarks extend losing streak to 5 weeks; Sensex, Nifty end 2% lower
text: Benchmarks extend losing streak to 5 weeks; Sensex, Nifty end 2% lower. Sensex and Nifty end about 2 per cent lower for the week at their lowest levels since June 11, while broader markets outperform despite widespread sectoral losses
